Fit genomic prediction models and rank parents

Source: R/hgsi-fit.r
hbr_fit_models.Rd

Runs every phenotype-dependent step of the HGSI pipeline: loads the pipeline output, builds the genomic relationship matrix, rebuilds the haplotype codes for all tested genes, replays the discovery gate inside each CV fold (M0 / M2 / M3), fits the final model on all phenotyped individuals, and computes the multi-trait selection index. Returns an `hgsi_fit` object that [hbr_cross_design()] consumes. Use this function on its own when the same fit will be reused for several cross-design configurations; otherwise call [hbr_advanced_decision()] which runs both parts end to end.

Usage

hbr_fit_models(
  pipeline_result = NULL,
  pipeline_results = NULL,
  trait_dirs = NULL,
  output_dir = NULL,
  phenotypes = NULL,
  phenotype_id_col = "ID",
  gate_params = NULL,
  min_concordance = 0.6,
  plink_prefix = NULL,
  weights = NULL,
  cv_repeats = 10L,
  cv_folds = 5L,
  top_frac = 0.1,
  min_count = 5L,
  strata = NULL,
  n_strata = 3L,
  strict = TRUE,
  final_model = c("auto", "gblup", "two_kernel"),
  top_parents = 25L,
  n_cores = 1L,
  boot = 2000L,
  seed = 1L,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

pipeline_result

A single [haplobreed_analysis()] result.

pipeline_results

Named list of results; takes precedence over `pipeline_result`.

trait_dirs

Named character vector of pipeline output directories for traits without an in-memory result.

output_dir

Directory for `hgsi_fit.rds` and the CV CSVs. `NULL` or `NA` writes nothing.

phenotypes

Optional wide data.frame (ID + one column per trait, plus PC columns if the pipeline used PCs).

phenotype_id_col

ID column of `phenotypes`.

gate_params

Optional gate override list, per trait or shared.

min_concordance

Minimum Jaccard overlap for the replay to count as faithful.

plink_prefix

PLINK prefix; default `pipeline_summary$PLINK_Prefix`.

weights

Named non-negative emphasis per genetic SD.

cv_repeats, cv_folds

Cross-validation settings.

top_frac

Fraction selected for realised gain.

min_count

Minimum training carriers per haplotype indicator.

strata, n_strata

Fold strata, or number of genotype clusters.

strict

Recompute GRM allele frequencies inside each training fold.

final_model

`"auto"`, `"gblup"` or `"two_kernel"`.

top_parents

Number of parents reported.

n_cores

Workers for the GRM.

boot

Bootstrap resamples for the CV comparison.

seed

Random seed.

verbose

Print progress.

Value

An object of class `hgsi_fit`. Feed it to [hbr_cross_design()].

Examples

toy <- system.file("extdata", "test_data", package = "HaploBreedR")
fit <- try(hbr_fit_models(
  trait_dirs   = c(trait1 = toy),
  plink_prefix = file.path(toy, "test"),
  output_dir   = tempdir(),
  cv_repeats   = 1L, cv_folds = 2L, strict = FALSE,
  verbose      = FALSE))
